title: Filter Toolbar
description: The working bar above every real list: search, two filters, a sort, and a density switch.
usage: Composes the Input search wrap, two Selects, a Segmented view switch and one quiet button — nothing custom but the frame. It sits above data tables, file lists and galleries; the result count belongs at its right end, updated in words ("128 orders") and visible without hovering. On narrow screens it wraps in reading order: search first, always.
